title: Parents' music: father's ministry and mother's church singing
summary: He describes his father as a Baptist minister and his mother as a church singer.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: That covers, I think most of your jobs pretty well. We might talk for a few minutes we have left. Yeah. But you can remember anything else about your father and the type of music he played or any early bands he might have played in?

I wondered if he played in any bands or just…

Yeah, that part I wouldn't know. Did your mother sing or play? My mother was the number one singer. Now she was a good entertainer at the church from a little girl at Thompson and Me Chapel. Used to be on Send Rock and… Was that Methodist?
He was Baptist, my mother was Methodist.

Oh, that's right. Yeah. And she sang from a little girl who played concerts and sang in the church.
